report.verdict: An emergency nurse manager whose profile shows how she improved patient flow, retention and budget performance.
write_up: You lead an emergency department at a Level II trauma center, and your profile makes the work unmistakable! It shows the people and budget you manage, as well as what changed under your leadership.
The Saguaro Valley manager job is the model: you connect front-door triage and the overflow plan to fewer patients leaving without being seen. You also show the changes behind lower RN turnover.

There's no urgent rewrite here. Your About already brings the patient-flow result to the top, and the experience underneath backs it up. Your profile isn't the reason a recruiter would pass; the requirements and timing of a particular role still matter.

cards.where: Saguaro Valley Medical Center, Nurse Manager description
cards.line: Cut left-without-being-seen from 5.1% to 2.3% in two years with front-door triage and a new overflow plan.
cards.cannot_tell: This is the line to keep as a model. It names what changed and the two steps behind it, so a recruiter can understand your work without guessing.
